enchantments.tooltip: Acid Lore IV: Passive: Your Acid spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Sonic Lore IV: Passive: Your Sonic spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Proof Against Poison +6: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +6 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
